```{=html}
<style>
/* ========================================================================
   Blog listing polish — page-scoped (do not move to theme files).
   Reuses theme custom properties (--terminal-primary, --spacing-unit,
   --border-radius, --transition-fast) and Bootstrap variables so the
   light/dark themes keep working untouched.
   ======================================================================== */

/* Post rows: quiet separators; terminal-primary accent on hover */
.quarto-listing .quarto-post {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
  padding: calc(var(--spacing-unit) * 1.5) 0;
  transition: border-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.quarto-listing .quarto-post:first-of-type {
  padding-top: calc(var(--spacing-unit) * 0.5);
}

.quarto-listing .quarto-post:hover {
  border-bottom-color: var(--terminal-primary);
}

/* Titles: clean anchors, terminal-colored underline on hover */
.quarto-listing .listing-title a {
  text-decoration: none;
}

.quarto-listing .listing-title a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-color: var(--terminal-primary);
  text-underline-offset: 0.2em;
}

/* Metadata: compact + secondary */
.quarto-listing .listing-date,
.quarto-listing .listing-description {
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
}

/* Category pills on each post */
.quarto-listing .listing-category {
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
  border-radius: var(--border-radius);
  padding: 0.1em 0.5em;
  font-size: 0.8em;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.quarto-listing .listing-category:hover {
  color: var(--terminal-primary);
  border-color: var(--terminal-primary);
  text-decoration: none;
}

/* Category filter block (rendered above the listing when categories: true) */
.quarto-listing-category-title {
  font-size: 0.85em;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}

.quarto-listing-category .quarto-category {
  display: inline-block;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
  border-radius: var(--border-radius);
  padding: 0.1em 0.6em;
  margin-right: 0.25em;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.quarto-listing-category .quarto-category:hover,
.quarto-listing-category .quarto-category.active {
  color: var(--terminal-primary);
  border-color: var(--terminal-primary);
}

/* Graceful degradation: when no post has categories yet, the filter holds
   only "All" — hide it so a one-post archive still looks intentional.
   If Quarto's markup differs, this rule simply never matches (no-op). */
.quarto-listing-category:has(.quarto-category:only-child) {
  display: none;
}

/* Empty-filter message, if it is ever reached */
.quarto-listing .listing-no-matching {
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  border: 1px dashed var(--bs-border-color);
  border-radius: var(--border-radius);
  padding: var(--spacing-unit) calc(var(--spacing-unit) * 1.5);
}
</style>
```
